scope: Aswan High Dam main mapped rock-fill embankment and crest road/physical parapets. Model the complete native visible main dam body, not a generic vertical concrete wall. Detached electrical facilities, villages, friendship monument, lake/river landscape and Low Dam excluded.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with published Qualla originals. Two clearly released PD-self photographs by Ijanderson977 selected. No additional image source needed; primary government text supplies engineering dimensions. Artwork plaque and irrelevant/uncertain images excluded.

originalReview.notes: Both exact3072x2304Ijanderson977public-domain Qualla originals inspected. They show the sloping stone/riprap dam face below the crest, a lower service-road terrace and pale marker/barrier details.02also shows detached electrical substation;04shows riverbank/road approach. These are controls for exposed surface/terrace appearance, not a full aerial or engineering cross-section. Plaque, downstream river-only photos, medical/map graphics and unrelated temples are excluded.
